items.followUp: Calculate the pressure exerted by a 50 cm column of water. Take the density of water as 1000 kg m⁻³ and g = 9.8 m s⁻².

rubric.why: The height is converted to SI units before substitution.
rubric.description: Converts the column height to 0.76 m.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the correct SI height.

rubric.why: This is the relation for pressure due to a liquid column.

rubric.why: The given values are correctly substituted into the formula.
rubric.description: Substitutes the density, gravitational acceleration, and height.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the correct substitution using SI values.

rubric.why: The calculation gives the pressure exerted by the mercury column.
rubric.description: Calculates the pressure as approximately 1.01 × 10⁵ Pa.

modelAnswer: Given: h = 76 cm = 0.76 m, ρ = 13.6 × 10³ kg m⁻³, g = 9.8 m s⁻².
Substitution: p = (13.6 × 10³ kg m⁻³)(9.8 m s⁻²)(0.76 m).
